abilities.name: Crescent Blade
abilities.rawDescription: Round 1: Grant Crescent Blade to 1 other Ally Sentinel in any lane until the end of battle. When this target deals Tactical Damage, or applies Recovery, 50% chance to grant Moondancer 1 stack of Rising Tide (Max 8 stacks). This effect cannot trigger more than once per round. Each stack of Rising Tide reduces Moondancer's Damage Received by 2%. Even-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: 75%). At 6+ Stars, Full Moon replaces this rate with its Habit-level progression and doubles the active rate when Moondancer has 4+ Rising Tide stacks.

abilities.name: Warrior's Zeal
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in Vanguard, increase Moondancer's Physical Damage Dealt by 16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in Left Flank.

abilities.name: New Moon
abilities.rawDescription: Rounds 1, 3, 5: 25%/30%/35%/42.5%/50% chance by Habit Level to gain 1 Rising Tide stack; if any Ally has Advantage, deterministically double the chance to 50%/60%/70%/85%/100%. Odd-numbered Rounds: increase Instinct by 9%/10.8%/12.6%/15.3%/18% (enhanced by Initiative) and Tactical Damage Dealt by 6%/7.2%/8.4%/10.2%/12% of 1 other Ally Sentinel for 2 rounds. At 4+ Rising Tide stacks, multiply both support effects by 1.5.

abilities.name: Reactive Instincts
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Combat: increase Instinct by 22%/26.4%/30.8%/37.4%/44% and Initiative by 11%/13.2%/15.4%/18.7%/22% of the Ally with the highest Instinct until the end of combat. Both effects are enhanced by Strength. A unique highest-Instinct target resolves deterministically; an unverified tie remains unresolved.

abilities.name: Full Moon
abilities.rawDescription: Rounds 6, 8, 10: 25%/30%/35%/42.5%/50% chance by Habit Level to gain 1 Rising Tide stack; if any Ally has Advantage, double the chance to 50%/60%/70%/85%/100%. Additionally, gain 1 stack if Moondancer has the least troops of all combatants. Crescent Blade Physical Damage Rate becomes 85%/92%/99%/109.5%/120%; at 4+ Rising Tide stacks, double that rate to 170%/184%/198%/219%/240%.

abilities.name: Blood Moon
abilities.rawDescription: Each Round: if Moondancer has 4+ Rising Tide stacks, increase Physical Damage Dealt by 12.5%/15%/17.5%/21.25%/25% until end of the round. Odd-numbered Rounds: 25%/30%/35%/42.5%/50% chance to afflict Bleed on 2 Enemies within adjacency for 2 rounds; at 6+ Rising Tide stacks, double the chance to 50%/60%/70%/85%/100%. The screenshot does not establish whether the two targets share one roll or receive separate rolls.

abilities.name: Eclipsing Strike
abilities.rawDescription: Each Round: 20%/26%/32%/40%/50% chance by Habit Level to reduce Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the Most Troops by 18% for 2 rounds. At 6+ Rising Tide stacks, double the activation chance to 40%/52%/64%/80%/100% and also reduce the same target's Initiative by 25%, enhanced by Initiative. The two reductions share the successful Eclipsing Strike activation. An unverified highest-troop tie remains unresolved.
